      "observations": [
        "Owned human two-file deletion read in full. The patch removes nsITransportEventSink from nsMsgProtocol inheritance, its support macro and declaration, deletes OnTransportStatus, and removes the matching SetEventSink(nullptr,nullptr) teardown block. The retired method ignored background/no-URL requests and send/receive byte-status events, lazily obtained a progress sink, resolved a display hostname through the incoming server, and forwarded OnStatus. This entry does not add a replacement implementation or changed tests.",
        "Bounded earlier caller proof: Bug 1851535 commit f6234f3e8945b7c9a943c607b461a26417fd239f metadata names only shared Thunderbird paths and explains retired native SMTP/POP3/NNTP code. Its parent a5ca7ce85f19616333ef16e5b4ce072cf4c180c1 has OpenNetworkSocketWithInfo registering strans->SetEventSink(this,currentThread). The selected after-source window and scoped symbol search show that registration method is gone while only the null-sink teardown remains. These exact earlier windows support the linkage without claiming the whole earlier patch was read or auditing that earlier entry.",
        "Accepted source retains the same removal. OpenFileSocket now creates an input transport; CloseSocket still cancels the request, clears it and closes/releases m_transport. Channel notification callbacks remain separate. IMAP and Mailbox both still derive from nsMsgProtocol, so a narrow class scan must not incorrectly conclude Mailbox is the sole consumer. IMAP has an independent nsImapTransportEventSink, registers it with m_transport, and forwards callbacks to its proxy. Removing the base class sink is not removing all IMAP transport-status handling.",
        "The changed C++ preserves the existing interface-macro style and whole-function removal. The deleted callback's guard returns and cleanup comments describe the old path; they do not establish a new global return or socket-cleanup rule. Existing base header comments mention several old protocol families, so current inheritance and registration sites are the stronger behavior evidence. No new assertion or test body is introduced in this entry.",
        "Full retained Bug 1970022 current available description/comments 0–37/footer read, with robot 27 explicitly excluded by original scope. Comments 17/18 are this sink removal and landing; the other account, taskgraph, view, CSS and later Calendar cleanup stages remain separate. Comment 34 explicitly describes a different still-reachable but broken path, so the umbrella Dead code removal title is not proof that every related patch is unreachable. Historical author ownership prose is not current task authority. Full own D272126 has no submitted inlines/summary/test-plan edits. No transport/progress or native build execution."
